The payment is currently unreconciled. The original explanation classified this as a "partial_payment" pattern, which typically means a payment that covers only part of an invoice. But looking at the evidence, the payment amount exactly matches the full invoice amount for INV-00148.

Let me consider an alternative interpretation: the payment could be matched to a different invoice, particularly one that was overdue (due before the payment capture date). For instance, several invoices were due on 2026-09-19 and the payment came on 2026-09-23 - these would be legitimate late payments.
